title: Superfun Social
tagline: A social meme app built with Lens Protocol where meme artists get rewarded with crypto for super fun content and brands can organize memethon to crowdsource memes from the best artists.
description:
All the posts in SuperFun use Lens social graph, store metadata on IPFS-Web3 storage, and are minted as NFT on Polygon blockchain which enables meme artists to claim ownership and proof of their creative work.

Note: We started this project during Polygon buidl hackathon last month using Lens protocol and continued it during Eth Online Hackathon. During Eth online we did the following changes: 
- Added Mirror functionality
- Fixed issues of collect functionality by which now if a follower "collects" a particular post then the creator of that post can earn crypto. 
- Started building a mobile app in React native where we are able to list publications (posts) through lens API but facing issues while integrating Wallet Connect. This is why post functionality is remaining in the Mobile app.
how_its_made:
To create posts we need to mention details like title, and category and select an image, add a relevant hashtag, and post it. The post will be minted as NFT in lens protocol terminology it's called publication.

Anyone who wants to create a contest can submit the details here and get SuperFun memes from the best artists. ( Under development)
